title: Unlocking Business Growth with a Marketing Consultant

facts.fact: According to a Payscale survey cited on the page, the average salary for a marketing consultant is around $62,000 per year.
facts.quote: the average salary for a marketing consultant is around $62,000 per year

facts.fact: The page states that 72% of companies believe successful marketing campaigns hinge on a consultant's expertise (no source is given).
facts.quote: 72% of companies believe that successful marketing campaigns hinge on a consultant’s expertise

facts.fact: The page attributes to Payscale the claim that around 82% of businesses that hired a consultant saw improved marketing strategies within six months.
facts.quote: Around **82%** of businesses that hired a consultant saw improved marketing strategies within just six months

facts.fact: The page attributes to KPMG the claim that companies working with marketing consultants reported an average ROI increase of 28%.
facts.quote: companies working with marketing consultants reported an average ROI increase of **28%** (source: [KPMG]

facts.fact: The page attributes to an Aspen Ventures study the finding that businesses using data-driven marketing strategies enjoyed a 20% increase in sales performance.
facts.quote: businesses that leveraged data-driven marketing strategies enjoyed a **20% increase** in sales performance

facts.fact: The page cites a Google survey finding that 75% of companies with an optimized digital marketing strategy saw a significant rise in website traffic and user engagement.
facts.quote: showed that **75%** of companies with an optimized digital marketing strategy saw a significant rise in website traffic

facts.fact: The page attributes to LinkedIn the claim that firms using fractional CMOs or marketing consulting services reported feeling 40% less stressed about their business strategies.
facts.quote: firms using fractional CMOs or marketing consulting services reported feeling **40% less stressed** about their business strategies

facts.fact: The page cites a HubSpot study stating that 75% of users never scroll past the first page of search results.
facts.quote: 75% of users never scroll past the first page of search results

facts.fact: The page cites Content Marketing Institute as saying businesses with blogs generate 67% more leads than those without.
facts.quote: businesses with blogs generate 67% more leads than those without

facts.fact: The page presents a case example, XYZ Corporation, that saw a 150% increase in organic traffic after implementing an SEO strategy crafted by its marketing consultant.
facts.quote: saw a 150% increase in organic traffic after implementing a comprehensive SEO strategy crafted by their marketing consultant

facts.fact: The page presents a case example, XYZ Corporation, reporting 25% sales growth within six months of its SEO strategy.
facts.quote: This translated to a 25% growth in sales within just six months.

facts.fact: The page presents a case example, ABC Enterprises, that saw a 30% increase in lead generation within a year after its consultant developed a content strategy.
facts.quote: Within a year, ABC saw a 30% increase in lead generation

facts.fact: The page cites a WordStream report stating that businesses make an average of $2 in revenue for every $1 spent on Google Ads.
facts.quote: businesses make an average of $2 in revenue for every $1 spent on Google Ads
